original_test_intent: Verify the raw Type 15 Log Header Format enum matches the approved no-header or defined-header implementation, is consistent with header/data offsets and persists after reboot without parsing unknown/custom log content.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 15 records, preserve header-format enum with header/data offsets, area length, access method/status and descriptor metadata, compare cross-field layout to the approved format and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the header-format/layout baseline and reboot plan. Parsing raw header/log contents under an unknown or vendor format is excluded.
required_inputs: Canonical or authoritative vendor definition for the selected format
Expected Log Header Start Offset, Data Start Offset and Area Length relationships
Policy for No Header, unknown and OEM-specific values
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read Type 15 metadata only; do not clear/write logs or parse raw log contents under an unapproved format.
Preserve raw enum because decoded labels can hide unknown/vendor values.
Require No Header to agree with the documented header-offset layout; require a defined header format to have coherent header/data boundaries.
Do not treat descriptor formats as the log header format or infer BMC SEL encoding.
Stop on unsupported format, cross-field inconsistency, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode the raw header-format enum, validate no-header/defined-header cross-field layout and compare pre/post reboot.
Do not parse unknown raw log data, mutate logs or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the selected format definition and layout rules.
Approve reboot/recovery, supply vendor format documentation where needed and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but the fragment omits raw enum, header/data bounds and safe parser definition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 15 metadata and validate header-format enum jointly with header/data offsets, area length and approved format definition; do not parse unknown log contents.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Log Header Format scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve the raw header-format enum, classify no-header versus defined/OEM format and validate the corresponding offset/area invariants across reboot while refusing unknown-format content parsing.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, format specification and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 Log Header Format enumeration, authoritative OEM format definition if applicable, platform layout and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum and cross-field safe-format validation to the isolated decoded label.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects format/layout contradictions and prevents unsafe interpretation of custom headers.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved format definition and complete header/data/area layout.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Metadata format correctness does not prove header bytes or event records decode correctly; content parsing is separate.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve an OEM header format only with authoritative documentation and matching layout; absent documentation is not permission to parse, though raw metadata collection remains possible.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity, raw format value/definition and layout policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 15 record with raw/decoded header format, header/data offsets, area/access/status/descriptors
Format-to-layout consistency result without unknown-content parsing
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot metadata diff without clearing logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The header-format field and related layout are unambiguous; unsafe generic clearing is excluded as nonessential.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw enum/layout validation remains possible even if unknown content parsing awaits vendor documentation.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum, no-header/defined-header layout and safe unknown-format boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains format safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE metadata classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates optional content parsing and engineer verdict from this static field check.

review_improvement: Prevents a friendly format label from passing with contradictory offsets or prompting unsafe parsing of undocumented log data.
independent_technical_reasoning: Header format is a structured enum with deterministic cross-field layout constraints; metadata validation does not require accessing log contents.
